message.content:
**YES readable**

All text inside the white cards is clearly legible with dark text (black, dark gray, or dark green) on white/light backgrounds. There is no invisible or cream-colored text:

*   **IPA Vowel Chart Card:** The title ("IL TRAPEZIO VOCALICO..."), instructions ("trascina: drag", "freccia: arrows"), axis labels ("anteriore front", "chiusa close", "posteriore back", "aperta open"), and vowel letters (i, u, e, o, ɛ, ɔ, a) are all dark gray or black.
*   **Live Readout Card:** The header ("LETTURA DAL VIVO..."), phonetic label ([e], NON ARROTONDATA), the large italic vowel (**é**), the Italian word (*pane*), translation (: bread), button text ("ascolta"), match percentage (66%), and feedback sentence are all dark green or black on white/light gray.
*   **Height/Backness Bars Card:** The headers ("ALTEZZA - HEIGHT", "POSIZIONE - BACKNESS"), values ("media", "anteriore"), percentages ("44% aperta", "16% posteriore"), and sub-labels are all dark gray or black.

The only light-colored text in the entire image is in the **dark "formanti stimati" panel** at the bottom right, where the frequency values (526 Hz, **2010 Hz**) are displayed in white/yellow against the dark background—not inside the white cards.
